svg.text: Pawn single push: one shift moves all 8 pawns
White pawns move north (+8), so we shift the whole bitboard LEFT by 8
plus black pieces on e3 and b4
e3 collides with a black knight
A set bit (1): a white pawn, or a square a pawn can move to
Black pieces (N = knight on e3, B = bishop on b4). They are part of "occupied"
A pawn landed on an occupied square. The & empty step deletes it
empty = ~(white | black). Each step is ONE CPU instruction that works on all 64 squares at once.
